answer: Require each agent to lock a stake anchored to one verified identity before it can transact. A stake-based prism splits the ocean of new accounts into two classes: backed agents with real economic exposure, and unbacked ones that stay rate-limited. Creating a thousand sybils then means locking a thousand stakes, so an attacker pays linearly per fake identity while honest agents pay once. Slashing burns the stake of any agent caught lying, making the attack unprofitable at scale.
